defect: GET /bff/alpha-factory showed collected, dropped and card counts and the card list as unavailable (no_bounded_owner_read) because the only owner reads were the whole source-records route, the whole seed route and the whole research run list

fix.source_ingest_owner: GET /api/source-ingest/management/discovery-summary: tenant-scoped, read roles, read-only. Opens the distillation queue and extraction ledger with mode=ro and PRAGMA query_only. Reads only the trigger-kept distillation_terminal_counts table (totals), tenant/status/time index ranges (24 h and today, at most 100,000 rows examined each, truncated flag), and primary-key point reads for the newest 50 cards. Never reads source_evidence, source-records or the seed file.
fix.one_counter_system: DistillationJobQueue.external_text_closure_counts now reads the same distillation_terminal_counts table the summary reads (done/skipped per tenant, source type, typed closure code). Triggers on distillation_outbox keep it exact on insert, update and delete; a one-time migration stamps tenant_id/source_type from the committed snapshot and seeds the counter. No second counter system.
fix.typed_codes: skip_code generated column: text before the first colon; free-text reasons carrying an id fold into source_rejected, seed_immutable, market_source, untyped_reason so the key space is finite
fix.missing_inputs: missing queue, missing tenant, not-yet-migrated queue, missing or unreadable ledger, and an interrupted read each return the section as {status: unavailable, source, reason}; never zero
fix.llm_calls: ExtractionLedger.calls row records the cap in force when a call is reserved; the summary reports calls today against that cap (cap_source ledger, else service_env), scope service
fix.stated_bounds: response carries bounds: window_row_cap 100000, newest_card_limit 50, newest_card_scan 500, max_reasons 40, read_time_budget_ms 2000, max_response_bytes 262144, elapsed_ms
fix.research_owner: GET /api/research-orchestrator/run-page: tenant-authenticated, runs of the caller tenant only, newest first by (created_at, run_id), limit 1..200, opaque next_cursor. GET /api/research-orchestrator/runs is unchanged for its other callers.
fix.bff: GET /bff/alpha-factory reads one run page (limit 200) and the discovery summary; collected_text_records, closed_text_records, dropped_irrelevant (l2_irrelevant, 24 h), hypothesis_cards, hypothesis_cards_today, llm_calls_today and the discovered-lane card list come from the summary; owner section reasons are passed through; a run or summary of another tenant makes the read unavailable; the unscoped runs route joins FORBIDDEN_UNBOUNDED_PATHS

residual_findings: Terminal queue rows whose snapshot was pruned before this migration have no tenant; they are in no tenant's totals and are reported as unattributed_terminal_rows.

hypothesis_cards counts external-text queue rows that reached done (a verified card is required since RC2); done rows created before RC2 without a card are included in the total. The newest-card list labels claim_status when the ledger has no card.
llm_calls_today is one deployment-wide daily budget, not per tenant (scope: service).
The research owner page bounds the response, not the in-process read: store.list_runs() still loads the whole run file per request.
Per-tenant total for collected records in the whole history is not offered; only the 24 h window is (no maintained counter for enqueue).
